bounds.quote: Lie on a bench with dumbbells pressed over your chest, palms facing each other.

bounds.quote: Keeping your upper arms still and angled slightly back over your head, bend the elbows and lower the dumbbells beside your ears. Press back to long arms along the same path.
bounds.bound: Upper arms frozen at 104 deg (14 deg past vertical toward the head) with elbow drift 0.00 across every 33 ms tick; forearms hinge from 104 deg to 236 deg so the dumbbells lower beside the ears (3D elbow angle = 48.00 deg <= 75 deg, |wrist.x - head.x| = 0.07 <= 6.2, |wrist.y - head.y| = 1.98 <= 6.2, |wrist.z| = 9.384 > 8.7); controlled lowering 1300 ms vs 900 ms press up.

bounds.quote: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar or a straight bar with a medium overhand grip, arms straight above the chest and elbows tucked in.
bounds.bound: Supine on a flat bench holding an EZ bar ('implement: ez') with rigid grip span 18.77 units (maxSpanDrift = 0.00 across every 33 ms tick), elbows tucked in at z = +/-9.384 matching shoulder Z, and straight arms above the chest at start (3D elbow angle = 180.00 deg >= 172 deg, upper-arm angle = 90.00 deg).

bounds.quote: Keeping the upper arms and elbows still, bend the elbows to lower the bar until it is just above the forehead. Straighten the elbows to return the bar above the chest.
bounds.bound: Upper arms and tucked elbows remain stationary (drift 0.00 across every 33 ms tick); forearms bend to 195 deg so the bar stops just above the forehead (2.11 units from forehead point, wrist.y = 35.75 > head.y + hr + 2.0, and 9.48 units higher than beside-the-ears movement 91; 3D bar-to-head clearance >= 9.75 >= 7.0); controlled lowering 1300 ms vs 900 ms return.

bounds.quote: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell overhead with an overhand grip slightly narrower than the shoulders, arms straight and in line with the torso.
bounds.bound: Reclined on a 128 deg incline bench with backrest and seat slabs supporting the torso (offPad - 2 = 4.64 = BACK_HALF), holding a barbell with a rigid narrower-than-shoulders grip (16.81 units < 18.77 shoulder width, maxSpanDrift = 0.00), arms straight (3D elbow angle = 180.00 deg >= 172 deg) and in line with the 128 deg torso.

bounds.quote: Keeping the upper arms still and close to the head, bend the elbows to lower the bar behind the head. Straighten the elbows to return the bar overhead and pause.
bounds.bound: Upper arms stay frozen close to the head (elbow-to-head distance 6.08 <= 6.5, elbow drift 0.00 across every 33 ms tick) while forearms lower behind the head to [222, -4.5] (3D elbow angle = 86.09 deg <= 95 deg, wrist.x = 22.25 < head.x - hr - 5, 3D bar-to-head clearance >= 14.72 >= 7.0); lowers slowly (1400 ms vs 800 ms) and pauses 550 ms overhead.

bounds.quote: Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley, kneel facing away from the machine and rest the head and the backs of the upper arms on the bench, holding the straight bar with a narrow overhand grip and the elbows bent.
bounds.bound: High pulley at [8, 78] behind the kneeling athlete (knees at x = 14, y = 2.01), flat bench at x = 60..79 (top = 24.5) supporting the head and backs of the upper arms (shoulder.y - armRadius = 24.66, elbow.y - armRadius = 24.66), narrow overhand grip on straight cableBar (span = 15.73 units, maxSpanDrift = 0.00), elbows bent at start (3D elbow angle = 77.09 deg <= 85 deg).

bounds.quote: Keeping the upper arms on the bench and close to the head, straighten the elbows until the arms are level with the floor. Pause, then let the elbows bend slowly back to the start.
bounds.bound: Upper arms stay pinned on the bench (elbow drift 0.00 across every 33 ms tick) while forearms extend to [0, -7] level with the floor (3D elbow angle = 180.00 deg >= 172 deg, |wrist.y - shoulder.y| = 0.00 <= 0.5, cable lengthens monotonically by +13.71 units, 3D bar-to-head clearance >= 12.20 >= 7.0), pause 550 ms at full extension, and return slowly (1400 ms vs 800 ms).

bounds.quote: Secure the legs on a decline bench, lie back and hold the bar over the chest with a grip slightly narrower than shoulder width and the arms straight. Lower the bar to the lower chest with the elbows in and press it back up.
bounds.bound: Decline bench at 160 deg (-20 deg decline) with ankle roller securing the ankles and backrest supporting the torso; rigid narrower-than-shoulder grip (16.81 units < 18.77, maxSpanDrift = 0.00); lockout has straight arms (3D elbow angle = 180.00 deg >= 172 deg); close-grip press lowers the bar to the lower chest (upperArm [-15, -4.5], forearm [115, -4.5], elbow travel 21.57 units).

bounds.quote: Then, keeping the upper arms still, bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead and straighten them again. Alternate one press and one extension for the set.
bounds.bound: Cycle [1, 0, 1, 2, 1] alternates one close-grip press (1 -> 0 -> 1) and one skull crusher extension (1 -> 2 -> 1); throughout the extension half (t >= 1700 ms) upper arms stay completely still (elbow drift 0.00) while the bar lowers toward the forehead (3.55 units from forehead point, 3D bar-to-head clearance >= 8.00 >= 7.0); both eccentric phases are slower than their concentric returns (1000 ms vs 700 ms).

bounds.bound: Starts in a push-up position with hands shoulder-width apart on the floor (span = 18.77 units, wrist.y = 2.35, 3D elbow angle = 175.30 deg >= 172 deg); lowers chest by 10.75 units (elbow angle = 65.98 deg), then pushes up fast (320 ms vs 520 ms lower) into flight where both hands leave the floor (wrist.y = 8.40 > 7.35) and land a short step laterally (step distance 8.85 units >= 6, body yaw turns by 16.00 deg >= 12 deg).
